meta.name: Make It Right 2026
meta.description: After his first love falls apart, a student grows closer to a quiet classmate as he and his friends face the highs and lows of young love.

videos.title: Unexpected Moment
videos.overview: Heartbroken by his girlfriend’s betrayal, Fuse finds unexpected comfort with Tee after a life-changing kiss.

videos.title: The Encounter
videos.overview: After their unexpected kiss, Tee pulls away, while Fuse seeks him out and Frame meets Book by chance.

videos.title: Deepening Bonds
videos.overview: As Fuse and Tee grow closer, their feelings deepen, while Frame and Book and Tank and Nai spark new romance.

videos.title: Unresolved Past
videos.overview: Fuse and Tee grow closer, but Fuse’s unresolved feelings for Jean leave Tee unsure whether to stay or walk away.

videos.title: Unexpected Reunion
videos.overview: Jean’s return reopens Fuse’s old feelings, prompting Tee to step away as every couple faces a turning point.

videos.title: Step Away
videos.overview: Unable to escape Fuse’s past, Tee steps away, while their friends overcome differences and pursue new love.

videos.title: Unanswered questions
videos.overview: As Fuse and Tee struggle with unanswered feelings, Fuse must choose between his past with Jean and Tee.

videos.title: Comes To Light
videos.overview: Fuse thinks Jean is unfaithful until the truth is revealed: the man she is with is actually her older brother.

videos.title: Own Choice
videos.overview: After clearing up the misunderstanding, Fuse realizes Tee is the one he cannot lose and must make his choice.

videos.title: Genuine Chance
videos.overview: Fuse asks Tee for another chance, as each couple faces challenges and learns to follow their hearts.

videos.title: The Trust
videos.overview: Fuse finally confesses his feelings to Tee, beginning a new chapter built on trust and mutual understanding.

videos.title: Stay By Your Side
videos.overview: When Tee’s past resurfaces, Fuse chooses trust, allowing them to overcome their final obstacle and move forward.
